title: Broncos are elevating FB Adam Prentice and LS Mitchell Fraboni from the practice squad

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos are elevating FB Adam Prentice and LS Mitchell Fraboni from the practice squad
sources.description: As expected. According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos are elevating veteran fullback Adam Prentice and veteran long snapper Mitchell Fraboni from their practice squad. This was expected after both players were released during final cuts. Both players are vested veterans and did not pass through waivers and could sign to the Broncos […]
